title: DCEO: Direct Causal Effect Optimization for Long-Term User Value Modeling in E-commerce Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.25635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial e-commerce search systems ultimately aim to optimize the user-level long-term objective, such as n-day cumulative purchases or gross merchandise value (GMV) per user. However, such objectives are defined at the user level, whereas search ranking is based on item-level scores within each request. Existing methods typically bridge this granularity gap through manually designed multi-objective fusion, where predictions of multiple item-level objectives, such as clicks, carts, purchases, and transaction value, are combined into a ranking score that serves as a proxy for the ultimate objective. translated_title: DCEO：电子商务搜索中面向长期用户价值建模的直接因果效应优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25635v1 公告类型：新 摘要：工业电子商务搜索系统最终旨在优化用户级长期目标，例如每位用户的N天累计购买量或总商品交易额（GMV）。然而，这些目标是在用户级别定义的，而搜索排名则基于每次请求中的物品级分数。现有方法通常通过手动设计的多目标融合来弥合这种粒度差距，其中多个物品级目标（如点击、购物车、购买和交易价值）的预测被组合成一个排名分数，作为最终目标的代理。这种手工设计的融合方案依赖于少量手动调整的权重，限制了细粒度的个性化，并导致与最终目标的对齐次优。在本文中，我们提出DCEO（直接因果效应优化），一种数据驱动的框架，用于学习与最终目标更对齐的物品级代理分数。
tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的DCEO框架，通过直接优化因果效应来学习物品级代理分数，从而更好地对齐用户级长期目标，解决了现有手动多目标融合方案中粒度不匹配和个性化不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven DCEO framework that learns item-level proxy scores by directly optimizing causal effects, better aligning with user-level long-term objectives and addressing granularity mismatch and personalization limitations in existing manual multi-objective fusion approaches.
